name: Brea Farmers' Market
tagline: Brea Farmers' Market — Beef in Brea, CA
description: Brea Farmers' Market is a farmers market in 145 S. State College Blvd., CA, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
